market_education.summary_en: Broad indices advanced today, led by strength in tech and semiconductor names, with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500. Several momentum candidates showed coordinated volume surges alongside bullish MACD crossovers, suggesting institutional buying rather than isolated speculative moves. No single headline catalyst was identified in today's data feed, so the move looks more like broad-based sector rotation into growth and semis.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤上揚，科技股與半導體類股表現領先，納指漲幅超越標普500指數。多隻具動能的候選股同時出現成交量放大及MACD黃金交叉訊號，顯示可能有機構資金進場，而非單純散戶炒作。今日數據中未見明確的單一新聞觸發因素，此波上漲較像是資金廣泛輪動至成長股與半導體板塊所致。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: When a stock's RSI sits between 55 and 70, it's rising with strong momentum but hasn't hit "overbought" territory yet — a sweet spot compared to stocks with RSI above 70. Combining this with a bullish MACD crossover and a volume surge gives much higher confidence a rally has real institutional backing, not just a short-term spike.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 當一檔股票的RSI（相對強弱指標）介於55至70之間，代表它正處於強勁上升動能，但尚未進入「超買」區域（RSI高於70）——這是相對理想的買點。若同時出現MACD黃金交叉與成交量放大，則更能確認此波上漲背後有機構資金支持，而非短暫的投機性拉抬。
